messages:
IncidentBot: URGENT: paging oncall — elevated 5xx + ws disconnects for enterprise.vpc.tenant=helixcorp across appgw cluster-eu-2, spike started 2026-03-17T09:12:10Z, ~120 errors/s :rotating_light:
Ava: Acked. I'm on it. Linking incident channel and paging SRE rotation.
Devon: I can see a ton of WS handshake 408/504 in the gateway logs. Looks like client retry loops — upstream app is returning slow 504s and appgw is dropping idle streams.
Mira: I'm on the customer call with HelixCorp eng — they confirm many clients show reconnect loops, some stuck at 30s before reconnect. They pushed a recent SDK that changed backoff behavior.
Sam: Quick ask: can we temporarily reduce appgw idle timeout and add stricter per-tenant rate-limits to stop the retry storm? Propose: idle_timeout=20s, rate-limit=50r/s for tenant=helixcorp.
Ava: +1 to rate-limit. Devon, can you patch routing rule to route tenant to dedicated-2 pool as a containment step? That gives isolation and better telemetry.
Devon: I can do routing switch. Rolling change command below (will take ~75s to drain/pin):
```bash
# route helixcorp to dedicated-2 pool
redwood route set --tenant helixcorp --pool dedicated-2 --drain 60 --force
```
Devon: Also flushing KV cache for that tenant to avoid stale session keys: `redwood cache flush --tenant helixcorp --prefix session:`
HelixCorp_Eng: Confirmed we can toggle client-side backoff to single retry for next 10 minutes while you mitigate. We'll follow your lead.
Mira: They're applying the client change now (says ~30s to propagate to major clients).
OncallBot: Ava acknowledged the page at 09:13:02Z. Devon assigned remediation at 09:14:10Z.
Sam: Pushing a temporary route-level header to instruct polite backoff: add `X-Backoff: 2` and set `Retry-After` for 503 responses. Example envoy snippet: 
```yaml
- match: { tenant: "helixcorp" }
  headers:
    - name: X-Backoff
      value: "2"
  rate_limit: 50
```
Devon: Routing change started 09:15:05Z. Monitoring metrics.
Ava: Customer impact summary so far: partial streaming disconnects, some requests returned 5xx before retry. Impacted subsystems: SSE/WS streaming only, REST endpoints stable. High-level customers impacted: HelixCorp production only (tenant isolation confirmed).
Devon: Metrics snapshot pre-mitigation: errors/s=120, open_sockets=6800, p95_latency=1.8s. After routing & rate-limit (09:16:40Z): errors/s=24, open_sockets=2200, p95_latency=0.6s.
Mira: HelixCorp reports client-side backoff reduced retries and connectivity improving. They still see occasional reconnects but not a mass storm.
Sam: Note for postmortem: likely interplay between HelixCorp SDK aggressive retry + appgw idle timeout mismatch + dedicated pool under-provisioned for burst. Recommend SDK backoff guardrails + default appgw idle 30s vs client default 60s mismatch review.
Ava: Initiating handoff to daytime oncall Jordan in 30m. Jordan, you'll take ownership of monitoring until full stability and runbook follow-ups.
Jordan: Acknowledged. I'll watch for 30m and then start RCA coordination.
HelixCorp_Eng: Thanks for the quick containment. Please keep us posted on permanent config changes and any required client releases.
Ava: Action items: 1) Devon: keep tenant pinned to dedicated-2 and monitor for 1h. 2) Sam + Product: coordinate SDK backoff advisory for HelixCorp. 3) SRE: postmortem with timeline + mitigation (owner: Jordan). 4) Infra: consider auto-tenant-isolation thresholds.
Devon: All set, dedicated routing stable at 09:17:23Z. Flushed caches, applied rate-limit.
OncallBot: Incident severity set to Sev2 at 09:18:00Z. Paging suppressed for non-essential alerts.
Ava: Closing communication for now, will update thread after Jordan posts RCA draft. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
